actions.explanation: A full missed-shot opportunity is charged unless a foul or retained possession changes the recorded outcome.
actions.label: Missed 2- or 3-pointer

actions.explanation: The shooter's ordinary free-throw weight.
actions.label: Unassisted free-throw scoring

actions.explanation: The shooter's share when the trip has an assister.
actions.label: Assisted free-throw shooter

actions.explanation: The passer's share of an assisted free-throw trip.
actions.label: Free-throw assister

actions.explanation: Charges the player for ending the possession.
actions.label: Turnover

actions.explanation: Treats the violation as a lost scoring opportunity.
actions.label: Offensive goaltending

action_groups.summary: Made shots use the shot-type shares below. These values cover misses, free throws, and actions that end or extend a possession.
action_groups.title: Scoring and possession use

actions.explanation: Direct value for retaining the possession.
actions.label: Uncontested offensive rebound

actions.explanation: The endpoint is blended with the uncontested value using the player's recorded contested-rebound rate.
actions.label: Fully contested offensive rebound

actions.explanation: Moves credit to the screener without enlarging team value.
actions.label: Screen assist

actions.explanation: Moves part of the creation credit to the extra passer.
actions.label: Secondary assist

actions.explanation: Transfers this share of a scored OREB pool to the successful teammate box-out player.
actions.label: Offensive boxout

actions.explanation: On miss → teammate offensive rebound → make, this share returns to the original shooter and is funded by the finisher and rebounder.
actions.label: Second-chance original shooter

actions.explanation: The tip winner and receiver each use this base share.
actions.label: Jump-ball winner or receiver

action_groups.summary: These actions either retain a possession or redistribute an existing scoring pool to another contributor.
action_groups.title: Creation, recovery, and hustle

actions.explanation: Credits the player for creating the possession change.
actions.label: Steal

actions.explanation: This is the familiar base value. The current volume_v3 result uses the location-specific block rates below instead.
actions.label: Block base engine key

actions.explanation: The current direct defensive-rebound endpoint.
actions.label: Uncontested defensive rebound

actions.explanation: Blended with the uncontested endpoint using the player's recorded contested-rebound rate.
actions.label: Fully contested defensive rebound

actions.explanation: Default 50% of the 5% DPV pool: 2.5% to the box-out player and 2.5% retained by the rebounder.
actions.label: Uncontested defensive boxout share

actions.explanation: Default 25% of the 20% DPV pool: 5% to the box-out player and 15% retained by the rebounder.
actions.label: Contested defensive boxout share

actions.explanation: Credits the defender for forcing the offensive foul.
actions.label: Offensive foul drawn

actions.explanation: Charges the defender for the scoring opportunity conceded.
actions.label: Defensive foul

actions.explanation: Charges the defender for awarding the basket.
actions.label: Defensive goaltending

actions.explanation: Charges the player for the technical free throw.
actions.label: Technical foul

action_groups.summary: Steals and rebounds use possession value. Exact blocks and defended shots use the location tables below.
action_groups.title: Defense and violations

boxout_policy.conservation: credit equals rebounder debit before factors

raw_component_weights.note: Current exact blocks use the location table above.
Current defended shots use the location table above.
Current offensive rebounds use direct rebound endpoints.

calculation_order: Reprice frozen semantic facts into component-level raw values.
Classify components into offense, defense, and other.
Calculate six exact full-lineup context factors and their Shapley contributions.
Apply sign-aware context adjustment and positive-only team close.
Allocate exact offense, defense, and other responsibility.

definitions.context_magnifier: 1 preserves, 0 removes, and values above 1 amplify
definitions.lambda: importance of the player's on/off performance
definitions.raw_multiplier: scales underlying play credit before context
definitions.reliability_k: shrinkage applied to small off-court samples
